in_marathi.name: Jayadeep
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory over deep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayadeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaya (Victory) + Deep (Deep, Ocean): This name signifies the victory over deep or profound aspects of life. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a sage who attained enlightenment after a long period of deep meditation.
